description: Returns a JSON object with projects (array), total, limit, and offset. Each project has: id, name, status, step, expected_clips, clips_count, duration, created_at. Use the status filter to find only completed or failed projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return. Defaults to 20, maximum 100.

status.description: Filter results to only projects with this status.

name: list_projects
